verdict.rationale: Convex's own materials list 'Crons' as a feature on its Free & Starter plans and describe a built-in scheduler for running background workflows, with 'workflow' named as a core platform piece, so it offers first-party recurring jobs and workflows. The evidence is only feature-list-level mentions, with no detailed docs on how schedules are defined or behave. Missing for 10: in-depth cron/scheduler documentation (schedule syntax, retries, monitoring), agent-driven (MCP/CLI) management of schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
